questions.question: Horse E was running ahead of horse D in the middle of the race. Horse C was ahead of horse A but behind horse B. Horse A was running ahead of horse E. From this point on, the fourth-placed horse took the lead and won the race. If the positions of the other horses remained the same, which horse was in the middle at the end of the race?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

⇒ Horse E is ahead of horse D.

E > D

⇒ Horse C is ahead of horse A but behind of horse B.

B > C > A

⇒ Horse A is ahead of horse E.

A > E

By combining above three statements the relation formed is :

B > C > A > E > D

At a point , horse at the fourth place cross all the horse and won the race.

**Horse at fourth place is : E**

E > B > __**C**__ > A > D

∴ Here, the horse that is middle at end of race is 'horse C'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**

questions.question:
If the first half of the given letter series is reversed, then which of the following will be the third letter to the left of the eighth letter from the right?

A U R R G H R S W C G I O P D S Q T
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Given series : A U R R G H R S W C G I O P D S Q T 

Total 18 letters are there in given series.

First half of given letters are : A U R R G H R S W

After reversing the first half of given series the series is as follows : W S R H G R R U A C G I O P D S Q T

The letter 8th from right end is : W S R H G R R U A C **G** I O P D S Q T

⇒ The letter **which is third to left of letter which eight from right end** of series formed is : W S R H G R R __**U**__ A C G I O P D S Q T

Hence, the correct answer is "U".

questions.question: A book which costs Rs. 40 is sold for 25% profit. If the cost of the book is increased by 10% and profit percentage remains the same, what would be the new selling price of the same book?
questions.solution:
Given,

Actual cost of book = 40/-

But,

The book which costs Rs. 40 is sold for 25% profit.

⇒ Actual cost of book + 25% profit of the book.

= 40 + (40 × 25) ÷ 100

= 40 + 10

= 50/-

**The actual cost of the book with 25% = 50/-**

⇒ If the cost of the book is increased by 10% and profit percentage remains the same,

New selling price = Actual cost of book with 25% profit + Cost of book increased by 10%

New selling price = 50 + ((50 × 10) ÷ 100)

New selling price = 50 + 5

**New selling price = 55/-**

∴ Here, the new selling price of the book is 55/-

Hence, the correct answer is **"Rs. 55".**

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’.

If U $ Q & Y % D $ S # K, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: D is the mother-in-law of K.
Q is the sister of D.
Y is the daughter of U.
U is the mother of D.

questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64886493bb300a8ef31f1507b44ed538becdacd7a98b6e26f230006fddf89fb3.png] 

According to the given information,

 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
A is

 
 
 

 
 
Symbol

 
 
 
&

 
 
 
%

 
 
 
$

 
 
 
#

 
 
 

 
 
Meaning

 
 
 
Sister

 
 
 
Brother

 
 
 
Mother

 
 
 
Wife

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
Of B

 
 
 

The given expression is :

'U $ Q & Y % D $ S # K' → U is mother of Q, Q is sister of Y, Y is brother of D, D is mother of S, S is wife of K.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81580ec437e30e0c0acd488f48ebf5000e0636f28f309c0922be38cfd43d09f6.png] 

1) D is the mother-in-law of K → True (As D is mother of S and S is wife of K so, D is the mother-in-law of K is true)

3) Y is the daughter of U → False (As Y is brother of D so Y is a male. Hence, Y is the daughter of U is false)

4) U is the mother of D → True (As U is mother of Q and Q is sister of Y and Y is brother of D so, U is the mother of D is true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Y is the daughter of U".**

questions.question: A is taller than B. C and D are of equal height. E is shorter than B but taller than D. F is shorter than C, who is shorter than B. Who is the shortest among all?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) A is taller than B and E is shorter than B but taller than D.

A > B > E > D

2) C and D are of equal height.

A > B > E > D = C

3) F is shorter than C, who is shorter than B.

A > B > E > D = C > F

∴ Here, 'F' is the shortest among all.

Hence, the correct answer is **"F".**

questions.question: The sum of the scores obtained by Ram and his two friends in an exam is 60% of the sum of the maximum marks for the exam for all three of them. If the ratio of their obtained marks is 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 6, how many of them scored more than 70% marks in the exam?
questions.solution:
Given,

The sum of the scores obtained by Ram and his two friends in an exam is 60% of the sum of the maximum marks for the exam for all three of them

The ratio of their obtained marks is 4 ∶ 5 ∶ 6

Ratio of Ram : Ram's first friend : Ram's second friend = 4 : 5 : 6

Let the sum of maximum marks for the exam for all three of them = 3M

Total sum of marks obtained = 4x + 5x + 6x

Total sum of marks obtained = 15x

Sum of the scores obtained by Ram and his two friends in an exam is 60%.

Total sum of marks obtained = Sum of the scores obtained by Ram and his two friends in an exam is 60% of the sum of the max marks

⇒ 15x = 60% × 3M

⇒ x = 4% × 3M

⇒ x = {3M over 25}

⇒ Percentage of marks scored by Ram = ((4 × {3M over 25} ) ÷ M) × 100

Percentage of marks scored by Ram = {12 over 25} × 100

**Percentage of marks scored by Ram = 48%**

⇒ Percentage of marks scored by Ram's first friend = ((5 × {3M over 25} ) ÷ M) × 100

Percentage of marks scored by Ram's first friend = {15 over 25} × 100

**Percentage of marks scored by Ram's first friend = 60%**

⇒ Percentage of marks scored by Ram's second friend = ((6 × {3M over 25} ) ÷ M) × 100

Percentage of marks scored by Ram's second friend = {18 over 25} × 100

__**Percentage of marks scored by Ram's second friend = 72%**__

∴ Here, Only Ram's second friend has scored more than 70% i.e., 72%

Hence, the correct answer is **"One".**

questions.question: When the petrol prices increased by 25%, Yogesh reduced his travel so as to keep his monthly expenses on petrol the same as earlier. By what percentage did Yogesh reduce his travel?
questions.solution:
Given,

When the petrol prices increased by 25%, Yogesh reduced his travel so as to keep his monthly expenses on petrol the same as earlier.

Let us consider, Cost of petrol = Rs. 100

When the petrol prices increased by 25%.

⇒ 100 + 25% = 125/-

So, the cost of petrol after 25% increased = 125/-

Percentage reduced by Yogesh to travel = ((125 - 100) ÷ 125) × 100

Percentage reduced by Yogesh to travel = 25 ÷ 125 × 100

Percentage reduced by Yogesh to travel = 0.2 × 100

Percentage reduced by Yogesh to travel = 20%

Hence, the correct answer is **"20%".**
